rateio.title: Credit distribution
rateio.description:
How much of the surplus energy goes to each unit, over time.

**History:** {historico}

tarifa.title: Solar payback — tariff
tarifa.description:
Energy tariff **before taxes** (TE + TUSD), per kWh. The payback uses it to value the compensated energy in months when the bill does not show it.

**In the bills already read:** {nas_faturas}.

**Where to find it:** on your bill, in the *Tarifa unitária* column of the consumption line; or in the [ANEEL tariff list](https://dadosabertos.aneel.gov.br/dataset/tarifas-distribuidoras-energia-eletrica).

**Was there an adjustment?** Enter the new value with the date it started: each tariff applies from its date until the day before the next one. To fix one, pick the same date; to delete it, leave the value blank.

Only here for the investment? Leave it as it is and save.

**Entered:**{intervalos}{falta}

investimento.title: Solar payback
investimento.description:
How much the solar system cost and when it was paid: it is what the payback has to recover. The next screen is the tariff.

Only here for the tariff? Click Next without changing anything.

horario.title: Reading boundary time
horario.description: The time of day used to align the bill reading dates with the sensors. Changing it recalculates all cycle history.

error.sensor_required: Choose at least one sensor. If the unit has no meter in Home Assistant, go back and untick that option.
error.sensor_refused: One of the chosen sensors could not be used for this quantity.
error.second_generator: Another unit already generates energy. Only one unit can generate: untick "generates energy" on it first.
error.unknown: Could not save. Check the fields and try again.
error.shares_total: The percentages must add up to exactly 100%.
error.share_invalid: Each percentage must be between 0 and 100.
error.distribution_refused: The distribution was not accepted. If one is already scheduled for the future it must take effect first; and scheduling needs a current distribution.
error.image_invalid: The picture could not be used. Send a JPG, PNG or WebP up to 12 MB.
error.swap_when_invalid: Enter the date and time the meter was replaced.
error.swap_refused: The swap was refused: the date must be after the current meter started, and the new sensor must differ from the current one.
error.amount_invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero, e.g. 25000.00.
error.tariff_differs_from_bills: The bills of this period show another tariff before taxes ({divergencia}). Check the value and the date. If the value is right, tick the confirmation and save again.
error.tariff_date_required: Enter the date this tariff started to apply.
error.tariff_invalid: Enter the tariff per kWh, greater than zero, e.g. 0.65.
error.history_keep: This quantity already had a meter replaced and cannot be left without a sensor: the record of previous meters depends on it.
error.previous_incomplete: Fill in the quantity, the previous sensor, the date and the hour.
error.previous_needs_current: This quantity has no current sensor yet. Pick its current sensor in the field above.
error.previous_same: The previous sensor is the same as the current one.
error.unit_without_meter: This unit is marked as having no meter in Home Assistant. To add sensors, tick "This unit has a meter in Home Assistant" under Edit a unit.
error.unit_has_share: This unit holds {percentual}% of the distribution. Set it to zero under "Credit distribution" before deleting it — otherwise the others stop adding up to 100%.
error.correction_refused: The correction was refused: the date must be after this meter started and before the next one ended, and the sensor cannot be the same as the next meter's.
error.previous_unknown: That meter is no longer on the list. Choose again.
error.distribution_when_incomplete: To use a date, also choose the hour; or leave both blank for it to apply from now.
error.distribution_unknown: That period is no longer on the list. Choose again.
error.distribution_edit_refused: The correction was refused: the start must be after the previous period's start and before this one's end, and only the last period may start in the future.
